about: The source model of a Zarr v2 store (spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §7 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#7-zarr-v2-profile>): the data types and compressors the Zarr v2 convention reads, and the roles a node's .zarray, its compressor and fill value, a .zgroup and a .zattrs play, each with the constraints a store must meet to have the convention's layout. The parser reads the listing and the documents (JSON by spec/zarrify.md §1.6 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify.md#16-json-documents>) and checks this schema for each node, in path order; the projection reads a valid IR and checks nothing.

about.int_ranges: the values of each integer data type, for its fill value
about.float_max: the largest finite value of each float data type but float64, by size b, compared as binary64
about.compressors: spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §3.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#31-compressors>: each id's levels (lo, hi) and the level numcodecs uses when the member is absent, and the members its codec carries
about.zarray_read: the members of .zarray that §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#3-arrays> reads; the others are kept in the source metadata M (§4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#4-source-metadata>)
about.filters: spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §3.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#33-filters>: the members each filter's codec takes

elements.about: spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §4.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#41-elements>: the store's directories and objects (conventions §8.9 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/conventions.md#89-stores>), and in each node document read, a value per top-level member

given.path: the array's path (/ for the root)
given.object: the document is a JSON object
given.dtype_problem: why the dtype has no Zarr data type (absent when it has one)

constraints.message: {path}: shape {shape} is not up to 32 sizes
{path}: order {order} is not C or F

filters.about: an array's filters (spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §3.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#33-filters>): list, the member is null, absent or an array of objects with a string id

constraints.message: {path}: filters is not null or an array of objects with a string id

filter.about: one filter (spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §3.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#33-filters>), given what it is applied to

given.members: it has only the members its codec takes
given.alone: for vlen-utf8: it is the array's only filter, on dtype |O
given.numbers: for fixedscaleoffset: scale and offset are finite numbers; for quantize: digits is an integer
given.before: the type it is applied to
given.dtype_kind: dtype is a type the filter takes
given.astype_ok: astype is a type the filter takes (for quantize, dtype itself)

constraints.message: filter {id} has a member its codec does not take
filter vlen-utf8 is not the only filter of a dtype |O
filter {id} has dtype {dtype} and is applied to {before}

fill.about: an array's fill_value (spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#3-arrays>), given its data type; ok: the parser's verdict for the families the table of limits does not cover

given.family: bool, int, float, or complex, time, text, bytes, struct or string
given.ok: the fill value is one the family takes, for the last six

constraints.require: !present(fill) || (family == 'bool' && kind(fill) == 'bool') || (family == 'int' && int(fill, first(at(int_ranges, data_type)), at(at(int_ranges, data_type), 1))) || (family == 'float' && (in(fill, float_words) || (kind(fill) == 'number' && (b == 8 || abs(fill) <= at(float_max, b)))) || (in(family, ['complex', 'time', 'text', 'bytes', 'struct', 'string']) && ok))

compressor.about: an array's compressor (spec/zarrify/zarr2.md §3.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/zarr2.md#31-compressors>); has_<member>: the member is written, null included

constraints.message: compressor is not null or an object with a string id
{compressor.id} level {compressor.level} is not an integer from {lo} to {hi}
zstd checksum {compressor.checksum} is not a boolean
blosc clevel {compressor.clevel} is not an integer from 0 to 9
lz4 acceleration {compressor.acceleration} is not an integer
lzma check {compressor.check} is not an integer
lzma preset {compressor.preset} is not an integer
lzma filters {compressor.filters} is not null or an array
